title: Inventory distributable Pico resources
goal: Determine the installation source, version, license/distribution status, and suitable Release/resources packaging strategy for the XRoboToolkit PC Service, xrobotoolkit_sdk binding, and Pico APK without modifying their installation or starting hardware.
doneWhen: Each of the three resources has a source/location and installation mechanism documented from local evidence or primary upstream documentation.
Each resource has a recommended Release/resources treatment that distinguishes redistributable files from external/vendor-installed components.
Any license, missing artifact, or provenance uncertainty is stated explicitly.
decisions: This task is inventory and recommendation only; it will not copy binaries, APKs, SDKs, or modify active installations without later approval.
System and hardware dependencies are out of scope per the user; only PC Service, SDK binding, and Pico APK are assessed.

verification.summary: Local artifacts, installed binary identities, SDK build provenance, and primary-source installation references were inventoried without modifying any vendor installation.
checks: PC Service Debian metadata and content layout inspected
Pico APK and PC Service SHA-256 values recorded
Installed xrobotoolkit_sdk version, binary dependency, and Pybind source commit inspected
Existing setup scripts and primary repository search results checked
limitations: No license or redistribution notice was found inside the local PC Service Debian package or APK.
The downloaded vendor binary artifacts must not be redistributed externally until their vendor terms are confirmed.
